==Usage==
Place <code><nowiki>{{LogoVector}}</nowiki></code> in the {{Tl|Information}} template on the relevant file page. Note that this template is used to denote vector replicas traced from logos; if the original logo itself is already in vector format, use {{Tl|Logo}} and add the file to [[:Category:Vector graphics]] manually.
